gloss: to become hoarse; to become raspy

definitions.gloss: to become hoarse; to become raspy
definitions.explanation: For one's voice to become rough, harsh, or gravelly.

examples.japanese: {風邪|かぜ}で{声|こえ}がしゃがれてしまった。
examples.english: My voice became hoarse from a cold.

examples.japanese: {長時間|ちょうじかん}{叫|さけ}び{続|つづ}けたせいで{声|こえ}がしゃがれて、ほとんど{出|で}なくなった。
examples.english: From shouting for a long time, my voice became so hoarse that it could barely come out.

notes:
Describes the quality of a voice that has become rough or gravelly. Most commonly appears in the た-form as しゃがれた{声|こえ} (a hoarse voice). Can describe a temporary condition (from a cold, shouting, etc.) or a permanent vocal quality (an older person's gravelly voice). Sometimes written in katakana: シャガレる.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- しゃがれた{声|こえ}: a hoarse/raspy voice
- しゃがれ{声|ごえ}: hoarse voice (compound form)
- {声|こえ}がしゃがれる: one's voice becomes hoarse
- {酒焼|さけや}けでしゃがれた{声|こえ}: voice hoarse from heavy drinking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {嗄|か}れる: to become hoarse — more formal/written; specifically about voice loss
- {枯|か}れる: to dry up; to wither — when used for voice ({声|こえ}が{枯|か}れる), means the voice has dried out from overuse
- ハスキーな: husky — a loanword with a more positive, attractive connotation
